# Bounded framing

Use only when the activation context grants `core.frame-artifact@1.0.0`.

1. Restate the requested outcome without changing its scope.
2. Separate in-scope work, exclusions, assumptions, dependencies, and open questions.
3. Cite the evidence supporting each material constraint.
4. Escalate contradictions, missing authority, stale state, or unavailable evidence.

Do not propose effects, targets, credentials, policy exceptions, or an implementation claim.
